tldr: Venus through the 2nd house softens money, security, values, and self-worth.
body:
When Venus moves through your 2nd house, it draws your attention toward money, security, possessions, self-worth, spending, income, and what helps you feel steady. You may notice what feels worth keeping, what costs too much, and what would help life feel more stable.

You may notice what feels wanted, valuable, pleasurable, attractive, or worth protecting. It can help you see what you actually want to choose, keep, enjoy, or repair.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for making a more honest choice around resources, desire, and value.

The caution: Watch for choosing the pleasant answer because the honest one would ask more of you. The risk is confusing immediate comfort with real security.

Venus moves through this house for a few weeks. Let ease show you what you value. Just do not confuse comfort with truth.
